data.name: Liberty Star Harborfest Fireworks Cruise
data.headline: Boston Harborfest Fireworks - THE BEST VIEW!
data.description:
#*Watch amazing fireworks from the deck of a real tall ship!*

## About

Celebrate Harborfest week with a BANG aboard the Liberty Star. We will be out on Boston Harbor from 8:30 to 10:30pm, with fireworks scheduled to begin at 9:15pm. Sit back and relax while you enjoy the amazing view of the celebration with a backdrop of the city lights.

Our bar will be fully stocked locally-distilled spirits, Boston craft and national brews, wine, soda, juices, and water. We accept cash, credit cards, or Apple Pay on board. 

The Fine Print: Weather can have an impact on the view of the fireworks. In the event the fireworks are canceled or rained out, a company credit will be issued. There are no refunds.
data.cancellation_notes: The Liberty Fleet reserves the right to cancel any sail for inclement weather, a private charter event, or other unforeseen circumstances. If the Company cancels your cruise you may reschedule to another comparable sail, or if unable to reschedule you will receive a full refund for the ticket price. We know plans change – if you need to cancel your sail please let us know more than 48 hours in advance and we will refund the full ticket price. We do not offer refunds for cancellations less than 48 hours before your scheduled sail.
data.booking_notes:
#Thank you for booking with Liberty Fleet!

---

Please arrive 15-30 minutes prior to the sail so you don't miss the boat! If you don't see the boat at the dock they are still out with the previous sail. 

We embark and disembark passengers at Fan Pier Marina; please see our website for a map and additional details. There are multiple public parking garages within a few minutes of the Fan Pier Marina.  If you enter “10 Waterside Ave, Boston” into your map program it will bring you right to the top of the gangway.

As it can be cooler on the water you may want to bring a light jacket or sweater. 

Please call our office with any questions - (617) 742-0333. Office hours are 10:00am-6:00pm Tuesday through Sunday.  We also have a "FAQ" section on the website.

Minimum drinking age is 21 years.  Onboard we accept Apple Pay, credit cards, or cash.

---

See you soon!
